KEANO Cervine 14 16 20 Inch Kids Bike for Boys & Girls
Built to inspire wonder and confidence, our bicycles blend timeless style with modern safety. We pour meticulous care into every detail, ensuring that your child's bike is not just a toy, but a trusted companion on their journey through a world of imagination. The KEANO Cervine Kids Bike comes with a cute basket and training wheels that turn each ride into a wonderful journey.

The KEANO Cervine 14 &16 Inch Kids Bike featuring removable training wheels.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Enjoy a safer ride! This bike has a rear coaster/foot brake for good stopping power and wide 2.125" pneumatic tires for added stability."
Engineered for Young Adventurers
Safety is integrated into every inch of the frame. This children's bicycle features a strong carbon steel frame with rigid suspension to withstand rugged toddler play. The fully integrated chainguard keeps riders safe and clean, shielding little feet and trousers from moving components. High-visibility reflectors are securely installed on the front, rear, and wheels to ensure your little explorer stands out.

Smooth single-speed drivetrain ensures simple, effortless maneuvering for younger children.

Child-Friendly Mechanics

Responsive Braking: Coaster foot brake offers intuitive, dependable stopping control.

Sturdy Foundation: Carbon steel construction creates an exceptionally strong frame structure.

Integrated Protection: Enclosed chainguard keeps fingers and clothes away from oil and moving teeth.

Get riding quickly! The children's bike arrives 85% pre-assembled with basic assembly tools included right in the box. A novice can typically complete the structural setup in about 20 minutes.

See It In Action Technical Specifications

Bike Type & Target Age: Kids Bike, Ages 2-13 Years Old .

Inclusions: Removable training wheels, front steering basket, bicycle bell, and premium DIY decals.

Our Guarantee
We craft our bicycles with maximum attention to quality. The KEANO Cervine is backed directly by our Limited Lifetime Warranty. We provide a hassle-free 30-day refund or replacement program if your purchase does not perfectly meet expectations.
